title: public civic appeal
context: Kushida appeals to bus passengers collectively to give an elderly woman a seat, and another adult stands.
observed_actions: Redirects social request from obstinate seat-holder toward entire bus
observed_result: Someone offers an elderly woman a seat
epistemic_limits: A single success is not universal altruism
